conditions: You can have only one active adversary. Clear or convert any existing Lich, Sister, or Coda before starting.
The final showdown is locked behind Saturn Proxima; check the Railjack requirements before investing in a Lich.

groups.place: KUVA SIPHON OR KUVA FLOOD, ANY
groups.activity: earn and crack Requiem Eterna Relics

rows.label: Oull
rows.note: wildcard Requiem; optional but very strong

conditions: Requiem Eterna Relics contain the eight Requiem mods at equal odds and cannot be refined with Void Traces. Kuva Siphons have a 50% relic chance; Kuva Floods guarantee one.
Each successful Lich vanquish consumes one charge from every equipped Requiem mod. With three charges per mod, plan to replace about one mod per Lich killed.
Palladino sells retired Requiem I-IV relics for 10 Riven Slivers each, capped at 10 per week; she also sells one Requiem Ultimatum per week for 10 Slivers.
bonuses: Oull substitutes for any Requiem and has three charges. Two Oulls cannot be equipped in the same sequence.

disclosures.title: stock mods before starting
disclosures.body: A new Lich is not removable until its three-Requiem sequence is solved. Bring a usable pool first so you are not stuck under its tax while farming your initial set.

groups.activity: Capture; spawn and inspect Kuva Larvlings

rows.label: Kuva Zarr Larvling
rows.note: weapon preview must say Kuva Zarr
rows.alt: buy a converted Kuva Zarr Lich from another player

rows.label: chosen progenitor
rows.alt: Cyte-09 gives Magnetic and supports Zarr ammo

conditions: After the screen flash, kill 10 enemies within 60 seconds to spawn the Larvling; add 10 required kills for each extra squadmate. Stand within 3 m of the downed Larvling to see its weapon before using Mercy.
If the preview is not Kuva Zarr, walk away and complete the mission. The shown weapon leaves the candidate pool until it cycles; aborting does not reject it.
The Warframe worn when you Mercy fixes the bonus element. Heat, Toxin, and Magnetic are all viable; choose deliberately, since Elemental Vice is a late-game alternative.
bonuses: Cassini Capture is the usual fast loop. Telesto Exterminate and denser Adaro Exterminate are alternatives.

disclosures.title: never abort a rejected Larvling
disclosures.body: Finishing without Mercy is the only reliable way to narrow the pool and force a Zarr. Accepting any Larvling clears the whole reject list, so do not take a consolation weapon mid-loop.

groups.activity: kill Thralls, reveal mods, and test the sequence

rows.label: revealed Requiems
rows.note: Murmurs reveal mods, not their order

conditions: Thrall Mercies build Murmur progress for the whole squad. Reveals are roughly 36, 60, and 84 Murmurs, while the final order must be learned by Parazon attempts.
Once one mod is known, stab whenever the Lich appears. A failed attempt ranks it up but gives the whole squad 10 Murmurs; only skip a first appearance if no mod has been revealed.
Begin each planet on a long Survival, Excavation, Interception, or Defense to bank Murmurs, then use short nodes when only rage is needed.
bonuses: A Requiem Ultimatum forces a confrontation; use it solo because it can pull a squadmate's adversary instead.

disclosures.title: use Oull to cap the guessing
disclosures.body: With one known mod, Oull → mod 1 → random; Oull → mod 2 → mod 1; mod 1 → Oull → mod 2; then mod 2 → Oull → mod 1 guarantees the kill by the fourth stab.

conditions: Choose Vanquish, never Convert. Conversion gives a tradeable Lich contract instead of the weapon.
The weapon bypasses its normal Mastery requirement when claimed from a Lich, but still needs its own weapon slot.
A vanquish has a 25% chance each to award Oull and a Requiem Ultimatum.
bonuses: The Zarr arrives built; no crafting materials or Foundry timer are needed.

rows.label: 60% bonus
rows.alt: stop at the first usable roll

conditions: Valence Fusion uses the higher bonus × 1.1. Results at 58% or above become 60%; a displayed 53% roll guarantees 60% on one more fusion.
Keep every copy and fuse donors into the highest roll, saving that high roll for last. Fusing low rolls together permanently wastes progress.
Start the fusion from the weapon you want to keep. Catalysts, Forma, Exilus adapters, Focus lenses, and Elemental Vice on the donor are destroyed.
Elemental Vice enables free element changes only after rank 40, which takes five Forma.
bonuses: Only one copy needs the desired progenitor element because Valence Fusion lets you select the surviving element.

disclosures.title: the 60% chase is optional
disclosures.body: A 25–60% roll is now uniform, but a maxed Zarr still commonly takes three to five full Lich cycles. Keep the first usable weapon, then treat 60% as a long-term goal.
